theme: Dark/Light Toggle, default to Dark Mode for the internal CRM and Light Mode for the Customer Portal

headings.strategy: Swiss Brutalist mixed with Industrial Tech. Heavy weights (Bold/Black) for dashboard metrics, tracking-tight.

monospace.strategy: Mandatory for all identifiers: Serial Numbers, RMA IDs, Part Numbers, logs, and dates in tables.

colors.archetype: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST + THE PERFORMANCE PRO (Industrial variant)
rules: Use high-contrast borders to define density.
Base UI is monochrome. Color is strictly reserved for Status badges, Alerts, and Primary Actions.
Do NOT use 'Teal Green' or 'Purple Gradients' as the primary app color. Rely on Solid Klein Blue or deep grays.

surfaces.dashboard: GRID BORDERS - Expose the grid for data-heavy sections (border-r, border-b with subtle opacity).
surfaces.cards: Flat solid background, 1px subtle border, no shadow. Hover states add `-translate-y-[1px]` and slight border darkening.
surfaces.headers: Solid Background with a hard 1px bottom border. Avoid glassmorphism in B2B CRMs as it causes visual noise.

textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity 0.02) over the internal CRM to reduce digital glare and add an industrial, tactile feel.

icons.style: Regular or Duotone weight. Clean, highly legible at small sizes.

component_strategy.tables: Data-dense. Use explicit 1px borders for rows, `tabular-nums` for numbers, and monospaced font for IDs. Include sticky headers.
component_strategy.status_chips: Pill-shaped, uppercase, bold 11px font with high-contrast text and low-opacity backgrounds (e.g., bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-500).
component_strategy.stepper: Linear, horizontal pipeline for RMA Job detail. Use 2px connecting lines and small solid dots. Active step is solid, past steps are checked, future steps are hollow.
component_strategy.forms: Use Shadcn components. Left-align labels. Inputs should have subtle backgrounds (bg-muted/50) with focus rings that heavily contrast (ring-2 ring-primary).
component_strategy.tabs: Underline style or solid block style. Do not use floating pill styles. Keep it utilitarian.

grids.dashboard: MODE B: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-6. gap-4. Every pixel utilized. Children must be h-full.
grids.details_page: Bento-style layout. 2/3 column for main content (Job Details, Activity Log), 1/3 for context (Customer info, Equipment info, Actions).
grids.spacing: Use p-4 and p-6 for internal dashboard widgets. Use p-8 to p-12 for Customer Portal landing.

layouts.navigation: Sidebar for internal CRM (dense, collapsible). Top nav for Customer Portal (simple, spacious).
layouts.job_detail: Header with massive RMA ID (Monospace text-3xl) + Status Badge. Left column: Timeline/Workflow. Right column: Assessment/Quotation builder.

motion.loading: Skeleton states mimicking the exact grid layout, NOT spinners.
motion.transitions: transition-colors duration-150 for buttons/links. Avoid transform on grids.

accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='create-rma-btn').
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings on all inputs/buttons (focus:ring-2 focus:outline-none).

media.image_strategy: Industrial, technical, raw photography. No illustrative vectors.
media.hero_overlay: For customer portal login: bg-black/60 to ensure text readability.

3d_libraries.strategy: Minimal. Avoid 3D in the internal CRM. Maybe a subtle Spline or TSParticles in the customer portal login screen for a premium touch, but only if performance allows.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install specific fonts: Cabinet Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, JetBrains Mono.
Build the dashboard using a sidebar layout. Prioritize information density and crisp borders over soft shadows.
Ensure all identifiers (RMA numbers, Serial Numbers) use the monospace font class.
Use standard Shadcn components for forms, tables, and dialogs, but customize them by removing border-radius to enforce the industrial look.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable for marketing/portal parts, but keep the CRM dense and structured.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
